record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only loss weighting: compute the existing softplus(-positive_score)+softplus(negative_score) mean separately over each sequence's valid target positions, then average over nonempty sequences. The current global position mean gives longer histories greater weight; equal sequence weighting may better match evaluation's equal weighting of users, given median histories of 7–8 interactions. Preserve sampling, features, embeddings, causal backbone, scoring/readout, optimizer, scheduler and training limits. Prediction remains unchanged, using one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Average the existing pointwise logistic loss within each nonempty sequence, then equally across sequences. This may better match equal-user evaluation by reducing the influence of long histories across all four datasets. Architecture, sampling, optimizer, training settings and prediction remain unchanged. Require the mandated data directory environment variable.
